# BronzeMetrics reference

Fictional independent test reference.

BronzeMetrics.aggregateSamples performs the supported operation. The sampleWindow field selects its parameter. The summary combines measurements collected during one time window. BronzeMetrics uses this operation and field together. measurements time window summary.

Use BronzeMetrics.aggregateSamples with sampleWindow; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
